# Methods text generated by BroodLink

Generated from the configuration and the steps that ran. Edit before use.

Analyses were run with BroodLink 0.1.0 (seed 1). Input quality control flagged samples with a call rate below 0.5 times the cohort median, pairs of samples with identical genotypes (theta >= 0.354) and outliers in heterozygosity or median relatedness; 0 samples were removed and 80 individuals were analysed. Markers were restricted to the callable mask (47,620,925 bp (79.37% of the 60,000,000-bp assembly)). 

Pairwise relatedness (theta, k0, k1, k2) was read from a precomputed table (plain TSV).

Full-sib families were defined as connected blocks of full-sib edges (theta >= 0.177 and k2 >= 0.15); they are relatedness-based groups, not pedigree records. This gave 15 families holding 72 individuals, 8 individuals unassigned; 7 families were closed (every pair passing) and 8 were not.

Candidate half-sib links were nominated between units (families and unassigned individuals) from the fraction of cross-unit pairs with theta >= 0.0884 (no upper bound, as in the original code), compared with a size-matched null of 5,000 permutations of unit labels (P = (exceedances + 1) / (permutations + 1); Benjamini-Hochberg q < 0.05): 7 of 253 unit pairs were nominated. Nomination is screening only.

Nominated pairs of families with at least 4 individuals each were audited on markers not used for nomination (DEL (gt:sv.vcf.gz); DUP (gt:sv.vcf.gz); allele frequency 0.02-0.98). Gate 1 compared the per-marker likelihood of one shared parent and of two shared parents with that of unrelated parents (genotype error 0.03); a pair was compatible when the first log ratio was positive and the second negative. Gate 2 compared the sharing of inherited structural variants with the 40 non-nominated pairs nearest in the Gate-1 score, once per variant class; a link was supported when its sharing exceeded the median of the Gate-1-compatible pairs in at least one class. Of 7 nominated auditable pairs, 7 passed Gate 1, 0 were rejected and 5 were supported.

Families and kept links formed a network with 4 components; supported links connected 7 families in 3 components. Latent parents (bookkeeping labels for maximal sets of mutually linked families) and violations of the two-parent slot limit were reported at minimum family sizes 4, 3, 2.

Large structural haplotypes were genotyped by local PCA (standardised dosage, three clusters on PC1 by one-dimensional k-means; individuals with a class posterior below 0.95 set to missing) and tiered on five criteria (separation >= 2.0 SD, heterozygote excess in the middle cluster, concordance of subset and full-cohort calls >= 0.9, at least 5 minor-arrangement copies, family eta squared above its permutation null): 7 intervals genotyped, 5 high confidence. An automatic scan (local PCA in windows of 25 SNPs, reimplemented from the published description; and linkage disequilibrium among deletions in 1,000,000-bp windows) proposed 3 candidate intervals, which are not validated.

The genotype of each shared parent at each structural haplotype was inferred from the descendants' genotypes (Hardy-Weinberg prior, Mendelian transmission with genotype error 0.03); 23 of 40 states reached a posterior of 0.9.

The variance explained by family (eta squared) was computed per marker class among individuals assigned to a family and compared with 200 permutations of family labels: SNP (bisnp): median 0.590 (null 0.245); DEL (gt:sv.vcf.gz): median 0.561 (null 0.194); DUP (gt:sv.vcf.gz): median 0.582 (null 0.193); HAPLOTYPE (structural haplotypes): median 0.607 (null 0.191); SNP matched to DEL: median 0.584 (null 0.246); SNP matched to DUP: median 0.584 (null 0.243); SNP matched to HAPLOTYPE: median 0.658 (null 0.232).

Kinship was computed from every marker class as a VanRaden genomic relationship matrix. For each class the rank AUC of within-family against between-family pairs of assigned individuals and the share of within-family pairs above the 99.9th percentile of the between-family pairs (recovery) were computed, with 95% intervals from a bootstrap over families (1,000 resamples): SNP (bisnp): AUC 0.9999 [0.9996, 1.0000], recovery 98.7%; SNP, SV regions masked (bisnp): AUC 0.9999 [0.9998, 1.0000], recovery 98.7%; DEL (gt:sv.vcf.gz): AUC 0.9988 [0.9957, 0.9999], recovery 82.4%; DUP (gt:sv.vcf.gz): AUC 0.9904 [0.9783, 0.9996], recovery 33.3%; HAPLOTYPE (structural haplotypes): AUC 0.8021 [0.7017, 0.8833], recovery 2.5%. The families were built from one of the inputs, so this is concordance between marker classes, not pedigree truth.
